title: Grocery Store
userGoal: Ask for basic items, prices, and quantities without freezing at checkout.
starterPrompts: Buenos dias, necesito arroz y frijoles, por favor.
Cuanto cuesta un kilo de tomates?
culturalNotes: A short greeting helps the exchange feel natural and polite.
Cashiers may answer with price, weight, and brand details in one breath.
It is useful to confirm quantity before you pay.
likelyMisunderstandings: The cashier may answer with brand names and weights faster than expected.
The learner may skip the quantity and get a follow-up question.
A polite greeting is expected before the request.

variants.title: Quick checkout
variants.setup: You are at a small neighborhood market after work.
variants.localReplyStyle: The cashier answers quickly and expects a short, clear request.
variants.pressureNote: The clerk may ask whether you want a bag and whether the amount is enough.
variants.starterPrompt: Buenos dias, quiero medio kilo de arroz, por favor.

variants.title: Produce stand
variants.setup: You are choosing fruit and vegetables at an open-air stand.
variants.localReplyStyle: The vendor speaks naturally and may bundle prices with a follow-up question.
variants.pressureNote: Listen for weight, price, and quantity words close together.

variants.title: Corner store restock
variants.setup: You are buying a few basics for the house and want to stay within budget.
variants.localReplyStyle: The clerk may suggest a cheaper size or ask if you need anything else.
variants.pressureNote: Expect one fast question about brand or bagging before you pay.
variants.starterPrompt: Cuanto cuesta el arroz mas pequeno?

turns.title: Open the order
turns.learnerGoal: Say hello and ask for the item with a quantity.
turns.repairCue: If the learner only names the item, ask for a quantity or amount.

branchOptions.label: Add quantity
branchOptions.prompt: Necesito medio kilo de arroz, por favor.

branchOptions.label: Ask the price
branchOptions.prompt: Cuanto cuesta un kilo de tomates?

turns.title: Confirm the amount
turns.learnerGoal: Understand the price and confirm whether the amount is enough.
turns.prompt: Claro. Son 1800 colones. Le parece bien?
turns.repairCue: If the learner misses the number, repeat just the price more slowly.

branchOptions.label: Confirm and continue
branchOptions.prompt: Si, esta bien. Tambien necesito una bolsa.

branchOptions.label: Adjust the quantity
branchOptions.prompt: Entonces mejor medio kilo nada mas.

turns.title: Close the purchase
turns.learnerGoal: Finish the transaction with one polite final phrase.
turns.prompt: Perfecto. Le llevo una bolsa mas?
turns.repairCue: If the learner only says thanks, ask them to add one final detail like the bag or the total.

branchOptions.label: Ask for a bag
branchOptions.prompt: Si, por favor. Y me da el vuelto, por favor.

followUpDrills.title: Add the quantity
followUpDrills.goal: Practice saying item + amount + please in one short line.
followUpDrills.prompt: Necesito medio kilo de arroz y frijoles, por favor.

followUpDrills.title: Ask price two ways
followUpDrills.goal: Switch between a direct price question and a softer follow-up.
followUpDrills.prompt: Cuanto cuesta un kilo de tomates? / Me dice el precio, por favor?
steps: Keep the tone polite and brief.

followUpDrills.title: Shadow a checkout line
followUpDrills.goal: Copy a realistic cashier line at natural speed.
followUpDrills.prompt: Claro. Son 1800 colones. Le parece bien?

followUpDrills.title: Dictate the price line
followUpDrills.goal: Write the number you hear and say it back clearly.
followUpDrills.prompt: Son 1800 colones y si quiere le doy bolsa.

followUpDrills.title: Split the checkout
followUpDrills.goal: Let one partner ask for the item and the other confirm the price or bag.
followUpDrills.prompt: Partner A asks for the item. Partner B confirms the price and bagging.

coupleSupport.sharedGoal: One partner asks, the other confirms quantity or price before paying.
partnerRoles: Partner A asks for the item and quantity
Partner B confirms the total or asks for a bag
handoffPrompts: Ahora tu pareja pregunta por el precio.
Tu turno: confirma la cantidad y pide la bolsa.
coupleSupport.keepBothInvolvedTip: Keep each reply to one useful detail so neither learner disappears into a long monologue.

listeningCues.previewLine: Me da medio kilo de tomates y un kilo de bananos?
